answers.text: "small reaction under the high, no chase" - My gate is the Trend Template, not reaction size: ma200 None and ma50 below ma100 leave criteria 1-4 unpassed (C3). D closes 19.1% above the 20.18 swing high, so no base pivot sits near price (C5); W has no readable swing. `mp` 97.0 and `mp_accel_state` 1 ACCELERATING are strength I never doubted, but `subcomponents.bq.bq_range_tight` 0.0 shows no contraction.

"extension past the pivot is the buy, not a fault" - In my method it is the fault: C5 bars buying more than a few percent past the pivot, and D is 19.1% above the swing high. `subcomponents.flow.cmf` 0.36 and `subcomponents.structure.wk_score` 15.0 confirm demand, but W has no readable swing and ma200 None leaves the Trend Template unpassed (C2, C3). A different method, not evidence against my test.

"my test needs an ADX trend or a coil" - ADX is not in the Trend Template; the MA stack is, and it passes (C3). `subcomponents.energy.squeeze_score` 0.0 shows no measured coil, but `subcomponents.structure.base_score` 15.0 on `subcomponents.structure.base_days` 17.0 is the base, and the expansion bar is the C6 breakout. W sits 3.5% under the weekly high: the pivot is the weekly base top, so I time on it.
